result.markdown: --- title: "Install R and required packages" editor: visual format: html: toc: false --- ## R and RStudio To work in R, you'll need to install R and RStudio. Both programs are free and easy to download. For an easy step by step, follow the procedure described [here](https://rstudio-education.github.io/hopr/starting.html#using-r). ::: callout-tip ### Set working directory In each of your script, always start with setting the working directory to avoid issues with folder structure and ensure that your RData is saved in the proper location. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} setwd("some_folder/my_working_directory") ``` ::: ::: ## Required packages Some packages from the CRAN are required to run the examples on this website. Download the script `001_required_packages.R`, or copy the codes below into your own script. ::: {.cell} ::: ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Install packages install.packages("openxlsx") install.packages("dplyr") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Load packages library(openxlsx) library(dplyr) ``` :::
